What changed on [[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V)]] between [[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V) (Errata 2)]] (left) and [[Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut (V) (Errata 3)]] (right): whole card images cropped from the two published Players Committee card images, pixels unchanged, placed side by side. Left: [[:File:V14-L-endorchiefchirpashut-20230911.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/4f03b2d/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/endorchiefchirpashut.png Holotable commit 4f03b2d]). Right: the high-resolution PNG of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/endorchiefchirpashut.png Holotable commit efc26cd] (30 December 2024); the wiki holds it as [[:File:V14-L-endorchiefchirpashut.gif]], the card-size GIF the PC made from it five minutes later ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/large/endorchiefchirpashut.gif Holotable commit 9d2c01e]), pixel-for-pixel the same image.
